idle.label: Idle
idle.generationPrompt: Relaxed original idle pose, arms down. Six ordered loop frames: neutral, slight inhale, gentle closed-eye blink, eyes reopened, slight exhale, neutral. Feet fixed.

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.generationPrompt: Keep the fingertip touching chin thinking pose. Six ordered loop frames: original slight head tilt, gaze subtly up, thoughtful blink, eyes open, tiny head tilt settling, original. Hand stays at chin; feet fixed.

user-typing.label: User typing
user-typing.generationPrompt: This is USER typing, Astra attentively listens and waits; she does NOT type. Keep both hands clasped in front. Six ordered loop frames: original attentive pose, slight forward attentive lean, gentle blink, reopen eyes, tiny nod, original pose. Feet fixed.

responding.label: AI responding
responding.generationPrompt: Keep the original palm-up explaining gesture. Six loop frames: original smile lips closed, lips slightly open speaking, palm lifts subtly, lips close, lips slightly open with palm settling, original. No speech bubble, no text. Feet fixed.

working.label: Working
working.generationPrompt: Keep Astra holding the original open black and gold star book with BOTH hands. Six loop frames: original reading, eyes look slightly down, blink, eyes reopen scanning book, subtle head nod, original reading. Book stays attached to both hands, do not change its design. Feet fixed.

reminder.label: Reminder
reminder.generationPrompt: Keep the original small white envelope with black edges and star seal held in BOTH hands. Six loop frames: original presenting envelope, gently extend envelope a little toward viewer, attentive blink, reopen eyes with small warm smile, bring envelope back slightly, original. No additional props or effects. Feet fixed.

done.label: Done
done.generationPrompt: Keep original triumphant V-sign near face, other hand on hip, proud happy expression. Six ordered loop frames: original, tiny proud head raise, V-sign wrist tilts a little, brief delighted blink, eyes reopen and wrist settles, original. Feet fixed, no jumping, no effects.
